title: Book Two · Chapter 110: Before the Meeting
story:
After lessons, Ronan returns to the reading room. Jun is already there. Miss Wu has three empty chairs around the table. The materials room teacher sits in one.

Ronan puts the old sheet beside the new notice. The teacher has taken the notice down for this talk.

“This old sheet is from another term,” she says. “I keep it behind the room name because I need the book list on the back.”

Ronan turns it over. There is a list of old book numbers. He has never looked at that side.

“Did you ask me about Wednesday?” she asks.

“No.”

“Did I tell you the room opens then?”

“No.”

Jun keeps his hands on his knees.

Miss Wu puts the guide between them.

“Jun, which part did you do?”

“The book list. We walked the route together. Mei drew the route. Ronan had the times.”

“Did you ask him to check?”

“Yes.”

Ronan says, “He asked more than once.”

Miss Wu nods. She writes a short line on a plain sheet. Then she turns to Ronan.

“What must happen before Friday?”

“The time needs to change.”

“Where?”

“In every copy.”

“And the pupils?”

“I need to tell them.”

The room teacher gives him the correct line. Thursday after lunch. Return books in the same room. These are the times for this term.

“Read that back,” she says.

Ronan reads it. She points to this term. He reads those words again.

Jun asks about his leaf picture. The room teacher lets him borrow it today. But his own work is already late. Miss Wu offers him time at the reading table to finish the page. He accepts. He can finish now, but he missed the time for his work yesterday.

Ronan looks at the introduction card.

“Can I still explain the correction on Friday?”

“You need to explain the correction to the pupils now,” Miss Wu says. “You will not introduce the guide at the meeting. Another group can use that time.”

He feels his eyes sting. He nods before she can ask again.

“You may help with the corrected copies,” she adds. “That is separate work.”

The materials room teacher takes back the old sheet. Ronan keeps the new line on plain paper.

Outside, Jun turns toward the open room. Ronan turns with him.

“Can I help with your page?”

“No. I need the picture. I can do the page.”

Jun goes inside alone.

Ronan carries the guide toward the new pupils' classrooms. His title is still on the front. He puts a finger under Thursday on the correction paper and starts at the first door.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

correction＝更正；separate＝分开的；borrow＝借入；this term＝本学期。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan失去了哪个机会？
2. Jun接受老师什么帮助，又拒绝Ronan什么帮助？

## 读句子

**Jun / goes inside / alone.** Jun／独自／走进里面。
